verdict.rationale: The only multi-item operations in the evidence are a cloud backup and restore covering all accounts and a one-shot Export Passwords of saved autofill passwords. These are fixed, single-purpose bulk actions in the mobile UI, not general bulk operations, and the probes found no OpenAPI or other programmatic surface for automating them. Missing for 10: general multi-select bulk actions (e.g., delete/edit/move many accounts), any API, CLI or scriptable surface for AI-driven bulk automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
